## Design Taste
*Source: http://localhost:4321/ — generated by /taste. Full analysis: orbolo-localhost.md*

### Tokens
Colors: `#F8F4E9` (bg), `#516B3E` (text/accent) — exactly 2, no gray. Radius: 16px (cards) / pill (buttons), no in-between. Spacing base: 8px; only section break is 80px.

### Directives
Reserve contrast for the interaction, not the resting page. Never add a 3rd accent color. Keep photography out of the hero — it belongs at the choice point.

### Anti-patterns
Never: per-audience accent colors, a hero background photo, per-element margin (use container `gap`), an intermediate border-radius between 16px and pill.
